paragraphs.text:
It is impossible for Bernard to walk in his condition. Since life 
somehow lingers in his ruined body, you will have to carry him. 
You and Norman trim saplings into poles to make a litter.
Make a Listen roll: if you succeed, go to 464; if you fail, go to 467.
